notes: Housekeeping with nothing to see. The same handful of jobs — checking whether you're allowed into an app, saving a file, asking Home Assistant a question, running a background timer — were each written out dozens of separate times, which is how small differences creep in unnoticed. They're now written once. Two real problems fell out of doing it: the backups the hub keeps of your chores and wiki were stamped only to the nearest second, so two edits in the same second left one backup instead of two, and the tidy-up then sometimes deleted the wrong ones; and tonight's dinner card had a broken reference that would have failed the moment it was asked for a week's meals. Both fixed. Everything else works exactly as it did — every page and every button was checked against a recorded before-and-after.
